steps.license: Licensing: issue under an AIFC/AFSA licence or the National Bank's digital-asset sandbox; registrar and paying agent agreements.
steps.build: Reproducible build (`anchor build --verifiable`) and solana-verify against the repository.
steps.authority: Upgrade authority on a Squads multisig, not a single key.
steps.keys: Operator keys (registrar, issuer, paying agent) in an HSM or KMS, never in files on the server.
steps.funding: About 7.5 SOL for program rent plus operator SOL for fees; paying-agent float in the cash asset.
steps.kzte: Add the official Evo (KZTE) mint from the issuer in Admin → Cash assets and verify it on-chain — never by ticker.
steps.rpc: A mainnet RPC provider with an SLA; keyed URLs stay server-side.
steps.kyc: A real KYC provider in place of the SIMULATED review.
steps.monitoring: Alerts on failed actions, low operator balances and RPC errors; backups of the registrar database.
